thread:
Ava - Support: incoming from Acme Ads — customer reports objects with TTL expired (project: acme-ads, bucket: prod-events) are still searchable and show up in query results. They used the delete API and got 202 Accepted. Customer is asking for confirmation of physical deletion and audit log entries. ticket: #CS-8421
Retention Bot: automated: reaper-schedule last run 2029-11-12T02:00Z status: partial-fail (skipped partition p3: lock_wait) :eyes:
Liam - EngOps: can you paste the delete request id & a sample curl? also which retention policy is on that project?
Ava - Support: paste from customer: request_id=req_0b9f3a4c, timestamp=2029-11-10T21:14:02Z. They called: ```curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/acme-ads/objects/obj_9a12ff" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Request-ID: req_0b9f3a4c"``` 
Ava - Support: customer says policy is "custom:90d" (overrides default 30d) and there is no legal notice on their side.
Jonas - SRE: first check audit logs for that req id. If delete returned 202 we usually enqueue for async purge. Two failure modes: KMS key in HSM with pending operations or reaper job skip due to lock. I'll look at reaper logs for partition p3.
Retention Bot: reaper log extract (truncated): ```[02:00:12] partition=p3 job=purge_batch id=bch_331 status=skipped reason=kv_lock_wait
[02:03:47] partition=p3 job=purge_batch id=bch_332 status=error reason=kms_hsm_timeout
```
Liam - EngOps: kms_hsm_timeout is interesting — which key does that project use? ava, can you confirm key id (cust-managed) and whether it's been rotated or set to pending_delete in KMS?
Ava - Support: customer key id: projects/acme-ads/keys/k-acme-prod. They say they rotated keys last month but not aware of any pending_delete.
Priya - Trust & Safety: pinging legal/holds checklist — is there any internal hold flagged? If there's an internal legal or compliance hold we must not purge. Otherwise we can proceed but we need an ETA to give the customer.
Jonas - SRE: I'm spinning up a quick audit query: ```select event_type, ts, actor, meta from audit_events where x_request_id='req_0b9f3a4c'``` I see the delete enqueue at 2029-11-10T21:14:02Z, then a reaper attempt 2029-11-12T02:00Z skip, and a kms timeout at 02:03:47. Looks like the reaper retried and hit KMS HSM timeouts.
Infra - Oncall: KMS HSM timeouts usually mean the HSM cluster had transient latency for key unwrap. We have an ongoing SLA window for maintenance in that region earlier that morning — checking ops notes. If key is marked OK we can re-run purge after clearing the KV lock.
Liam - EngOps: suggested action plan: 1) confirm key status with KMS control plane (is_pending_delete? key_state) 2) clear KV lock on partition p3 3) schedule one-off purge job for req_0b9f3a4c 4) capture audit proof for customer. I can take steps 2-3 once key state is green.
Ava - Support: customer explicitly requested expedited purge and audit proof within 48 hours. They emphasized this is blocking a compliance attestation.
Priya - Trust & Safety: if customer attestation is time-sensitive, we may need legal signoff to proceed with destructive ops. I'll check: customer provided a statement that there is no legal hold, but we require a signed attestation for expedited deletion. I can reach out to Acme legal on the CS ticket.
Ava - Support: FYI customer contact is robin@acme.com, says they can sign. I'll ask for the attestation and post here.
Jonas - SRE: I pushed a small patch to the reaper to add more aggressive KMS retry for on-demand purges. I'll also unlock partition p3 now. ETA ~ 2h for me to verify logs and queue the one-off.
Retention Bot: manual_purge queued: job=manual_purge owner=liam target_req=req_0b9f3a4c created_by=Ava - Support
Liam - EngOps: queued and running now. I'll post results. If KMS operation fails again we'll need KMS team to triage HSM latency.
Infra - Oncall: opened internal incident INC-4572 and pinged kms-oncall. I'll add the HSM latency traces.
Ava - Support: telling customer: "We've queued an on-demand purge and are collecting audit proof. If the purge succeeds we'll provide timestamps and audit_event ids within 24-48h. If KMS issues persist we'll escalate to KMS oncall." :thumbsup:
Priya - Trust & Safety: keep me posted before you hand them the proof so legal can verify wording in attestation.
Jonas - SRE: purge run finished: job=manual_purge status=completed at 2029-11-12T04:12:15Z. audit_event ids: [ae_9c1, ae_9c2] (delete_enqueued, delete_finalized).
Ava - Support: confirmed with customer — they no longer see objects in search. forwarding audit_event ids and timestamps to robin@acme.com. They asked for KMS key rotation note; I included rotation metadata.
Ava - Support: customer provided signed attestation (uploaded to ticket CS-8421). They are satisfied and closing the escalation. :white_check_mark:
Liam - EngOps: closing loop — follow-up action: add extra KMS retry for reaper and improve observability on partition lock reasons. I'll open a small RFC for the change.
Priya - Trust & Safety: thanks team. Marking as resolved from compliance POV once legal confirms receipt.
Infra - Oncall: INC-4572 will remain open until KMS team confirms HSM cluster health. I'll update later.
Ava - Support: thanks everyone, I'll archive notes in CS ticket and notify the customer that we logged the internal incident and the mitigation steps.
